Blocks.Text: All job requisitions should be sent via the Middleware Platform whenever they are created or updated in your ATS. Use your job requisition identifier when syncing via the API.
Note
The latest API version is 202604. Use this version in the LinkedIn-Version header for all API requests to access the most recent features and improvements.
Note
Please submit batch calls grouped with no more than 100 records in sequential order.
Use the following endpoint to create and update records:

PUT https://api.linkedin.com/rest/jobRequisitions?ids[0].externalJobRequisitionId={id1}&ids[0].integrationContext={organization URN}&ids[1].externalJobRequisitionId={id1}&ids[1].integrationContext={organization URN}
Include the LinkedIn-Version header when calling this endpoint.

Rows.Text: The unique identifier of the job requisition in the partner ATS (maximum 100 characters).
The organization URN in the format urn:li:organization:{id}

Blocks.Text: Note
When updating an existing record, you must specify all available fields. Omitting a field will set it to null.
Note
The combination of the above 2 mandatory query parameters will be used as a unique identifier for your synced job application within LinkedIn in later requests.

Status of the Job Requisition. Possible values are Open or Closed. Available options are: OPEN,CLOSED

Type of Job Requisition representing whether it is a standard requisition or an evergreen (pipeline) requisition. Note that EVERGREEN requisition should not contain parentJobRequisitionId. Available options are: STANDARD,EVERGREEN. Default is STANDARD
Details of the job requisition owner containing first name, last name & email. List of complex type of firstName, lastName, emailAddress. Please provide at least one owner in this array.
Number of Openings that need to be closed with this particular Job Requisition
Used to represent parent requisition ID for a particular requisition. This is specifically useful for cases where multiple Standard requisitions are linked to 1 Evergreen requisition

Flag indicating whether the job requisition is ACL-protected or not.When set to false—all recruiters can view the job requisitions in the 1CE dropdown list.When set to true—if access group settings exist, only recruiters in the access group (ACL group) can view and search job requisitions in the 1CE dropdown list. If no access group settings exist, no recruiter can view or search job requisitions in the 1CE dropdown list.Note (version 202510 and later): The job owner can view all job requisitions regardless of the ACL settings.
Values: When set to false—all recruiters can view the job requisitions in the 1CE dropdown list.

When set to true—if access group settings exist, only recruiters in the access group (ACL group) can view and search job requisitions in the 1CE dropdown list. If no access group settings exist, no recruiter can view or search job requisitions in the 1CE dropdown list.

Blocks.Text: Note
For optional fields (non-required field), if the ATS has a corresponding field, please send the value. If the field is not present in the ATS, you may skip it.
Note

In production, requests must use query tunneling to avoid reaching maximum URL length. You can use non-tunneled requests when request URLs are shorter than length limits, for testing purposes, and for troubleshooting. Please check details on Query Tunneling Migration Guide.
You can use the x-restli-method header to specify the method as batch_update for bulk updates and batch_delete for bulk deletes.
A successful request returns a 200 OK response code, and you will find the status of each entity in the response body.
Note
Be sure to check the response for error statuses corresponding to individual entities you submit.

Represents the inclusive (greater than or equal to) value in which to start the range. This field is optional. An unset field indicates an open range; For example if start is 2 it means everything greater than or equal to 2.

Represents the inclusive (less than or equal to) value in which to end the range. This field is optional. An unset field indicates an open range; For example, if end is 5, it means everything less than or equal to 5.
